visual.general_description: Twelve-lead electrocardiogram on gridded paper with a bottom long rhythm strip.
visual.detailed_description: Black-and-white scanned ECG on pale grid paper. Three columns by three rows of lead segments are arranged with printed lead labels aVR, V1 and V4 in the top row, aVL, V2 and V5 in the middle row, and aVF, V3 and V6 in the lower row; very small labels at the left edge appear to read I, II and III, and a fourth long strip along the bottom carries a small label that appears to read II. The V1 and V2 segments show narrow downward deflections each followed by an upward rounded wave. The V3 segment shows an irregular, oscillating, noisy trace over its first several beats, after which the later beats look cleaner. The limb-lead and V4 to V6 segments show narrow complexes followed by upward rounded waves. A small bracket-like mark lies at the left edge between the second and third rows. No printed text other than lead labels is visible.

visual.general_description: Twelve-lead electrocardiogram on gridded paper with a bottom long rhythm strip.
visual.detailed_description: Black-and-white scanned ECG on pale grid paper. Lead segments are arranged in three columns by three rows with printed labels that appear to read aVR, V1 and V4 in the top row, aVL, V2 and V5 in the middle row, and aVF, V3 and V6 in the lower row; very small labels at the left edge appear to read I, II and III, and a fourth long strip along the bottom carries a small label that appears to read II. Narrow complexes recur at a regular spacing in every segment, with upward rounded waves after them in several segments. The V2 and V3 segments show deep narrow downward deflections followed by upward rounded waves, and no irregular oscillating baseline is visible. A small bracket-like mark lies at the left edge between the second and third rows, and a faint grey smudge with an arrow-like tail overlaps the bottom rhythm strip near the lower left of the strip. No printed text other than lead labels is visible.
